payload.name: AdKraft
payload.description: 通过照片制作视频广告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AdKraft turns product photos into finished video ads. Give it a product name, a short description and a few photo links, and it writes the script, generates the footage, adds a voiceover in any of 16 languages and hands back an MP4 you can post — in portrait, square or landscape, usually in two to five minutes. Ads are made on your own AdKraft account and use its credits; new accounts start with free credits, and you can check the balance or list the ads you have made without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: AdKraft能将产品照片转化为完整的视频广告。输入产品名称、简短描述和几张照片链接，它会撰写脚本、生成视频素材，用16种语言中的一种添加配音，并返回可直接发布的MP4格式视频——支持竖屏、方形或横屏格式，通常在两到五分钟内完成。广告将创建在您的AdKraft账户中并消耗账户积分；新账户初始赠送免费积分，您无需离开聊天界面即可查看余额或列出已制作的广告。

payload.name: Ullbek
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Describe your business or idea in plain words and Ullbek builds a real, custom website around it — actual pages written for you, not template blocks with a ceiling. Watch it come together through live preview links, ask for any change in plain language, and publish it to the web when it's ready. Every site gets a free address with free hosting included; premium hosting connects your own custom domain. No templates, no drag-and-drop, no coding — you describe it, it's built, it's live.
payload.longDescription: 简单地描述你的业务或想法,Ullbek在其周围构建了一个真正的,定制的网站 - 实际的页面为你写的,而不是模板块与天花板。 观看它通过现场预览链接一起来,要求任何更改的简单的语言,并在它准备时发布到网络上。 每个网站都获得了一个免费的地址,包括免费托管; 优质托管连接自己的定制域。 没有模板,没有拖放,没有编码 - 你描述它,它是建立的,它是活的。

payload.name: Namsiang Thai Voice
payload.description: 直接获取泰语音轨表演
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cast Thai voices by gender, age, personality, and role; direct emotion and pacing line by line for drama, dubbing, and narration; then create, track, play, and download private audio directly in ChatGPT without exposing provider API keys or voice IDs.
payload.longDescription: 根据性别、年龄、性格和角色选择泰语音轨；为戏剧、配音和旁白精准控制情感与节奏，逐句呈现；随后在ChatGPT内直接创建、追踪、播放和下载私有音频，无需暴露服务商API密钥或语音ID。

payload.name: Motionvid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MotionVid turns a prompt or a script into a finished motion graphics video. Describe what you need, like an animated logo reveal, a product ad, a how-it-works explainer, an animated infographic or a map explainer, and MotionVid plans the scenes, animates them, adds narration and music, and renders an MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.  Pick a style such as claymation, paper collage or flat vector, apply your brand kit, preview frames before rendering, and ask for changes to an existing video without starting over. Works with your MotionVid account on any paid plan.
payload.longDescription: MotionVid可将提示或脚本转化为完整的动态图形视频。描述您的需求，例如动画标志揭示、产品广告、工作原理说明、动态信息图表或地图说明，并MotionVid将规划场景、进行动画制作、添加旁白和音乐，并以16:9、9:16或1:1格式渲染为MP4文件。选择黏土动画、纸张拼贴或扁平矢量等风格，应用您的品牌套装，预览帧再进行渲染，并可在不重新开始的情况下对现有视频提出修改要求。支持在任何付费计划的MotionVid账户上使用。

payload.name: Lawh.ai
payload.description: 您可以编辑的层式设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lawh.ai turns a description into a real, layered design file in the user's own account rather than a flat image. It measures the text, computes the layout, prevents clipping, and reports layout or contrast problems so they can be fixed. Designs can be listed, previewed as images, opened in an interactive view where layers are dragged and text retyped, started from a hand-authored template library, organised into folders, and built with the user's own uploaded logos and images. Arabic and right-to-left layouts are supported natively. Finished work stays editable in the browser and exports as a layered Photoshop file with live text.
payload.longDescription: Lawh.ai 将描述转化为用户自己的帐户中的真实、层级设计文件,而不是平面图像。它测量文本,计算布局,防止剪辑,并报告布局或对比问题,以便它们可以被修复。设计可以列出,预览为图像,在交互式视图中打开,其中层被拖拉和文本重新编写,从手写的模板库开始,组织成文件夹,并用用户自己的上传徽标和图像构建。

payload.name: AdsTurbo
payload.summaryOriginal: Make AI ad videos and images
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AdsTurbo turns ChatGPT into an ad creative workstation. Connect your AdsTurbo account and ask ChatGPT to produce ad videos and product images directly in the conversation.

What it can do:
- Clone a competitor ad: analyze a reference video into a shot-by-shot storyboard and prompts, then generate a new video with the same structure.
- Generate video from text or images, including first/last-frame and multi-reference generation, plus extending or locally editing an existing video.
- Create digital-human spokesperson videos: pick a platform AI actor, clone a custom persona from a photo and voice sample, or lip-sync a portrait to an audio track (TTS included).
- Clean up finished videos: remove watermarks, logos and burnt-in subtitles, upscale to 2K/4K, and add or translate subtitles.
- Transform videos: swap the on-screen person, drive a static portrait with a reference video's motion, or translate a whole video into another language.
- Create and edit images for e-commerce: text-to-image, background removal, product and scene shots, campaign posters, and upscaling.

Generation runs as background tasks; ChatGPT returns a link to each finished video or image. All assets you provide must be publicly accessible URLs.

Requires an AdsTurbo account with a Pro plan or above. Generation consumes AdsTurbo credits according to your plan.
payload.longDescription:
AdsTurbo将ChatGPT转变为广告创意工作台。连接您的AdsTurbo账户后，可在对话中直接让ChatGPT生成广告视频和产品图片。

主要功能：
- 克隆竞争对手广告：分析参考视频生成分镜头脚本和提示词，然后按照相同结构生成新视频。
- 从文本或图像生成视频，支持首尾帧生成、多参考生成，以及对现有视频进行扩展或局部编辑。
- 制作数字人代言人视频：选择平台AI演员，通过照片和语音样本来克隆自定义角色，或为肖像视频添加唇形同步（包含文本转语音功能）。
- 优化完成的视频：去除水印、logo和嵌入字幕，升级至2K/4K画质，并添加或翻译字幕。
- 视频转换：替换屏幕人物，用参考视频的动作驱动静态肖像，或整片翻译成其他语言。
- 制作电商图片：文本生成图像、背景消除、产品与场景拍摄、活动海报制作及画质提升。

生成过程作为后台任务运行；ChatGPT会为每个完成的视频或图片返回链接。您提供的所有素材必须为公开可访问的URL。

需要拥有专业版或更高计划的AdsTurbo账户。生成内容将根据您的计划消耗AdsTurbo积分。

payload.name: Treza
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Treza makes and finishes videos from ChatGPT. Describe a video and Treza builds it with current video and image models, narration, music and captions, then renders it on your Treza account. You can also work with media you already have: join clips into one video over a voiceover and a music bed, or caption, upscale, crop or trim a single file.

What you can do:
- Start from a ready-made template, such as turning a long video or podcast into captioned vertical clips, or build a custom pipeline from a brief.
- Run a pipeline and follow it to the finished video.
- Check what a run will cost before spending, and see your credit balance.
- Browse the videos, images and audio your account has made.
- Add an image, video or audio file you attach or link, then edit it.
- Publish a pipeline and pause or resume its schedule.
- Connect your YouTube channel or TikTok account, and post a finished video after you review it. Nothing is posted until you press Post.

Runs spend prepaid credits from your Treza account. You sign in with Google when you connect, which creates a Treza account if you don't have one. Posting needs your own YouTube channel or TikTok account, which you connect from a link Treza gives you in the chat.
payload.longDescription:
Treza 通过 ChatGPT 制作并完成视频。描述一个视频内容，Treza 将使用当前视频和图像模型、旁白、音乐及字幕来构建视频，并在您的 Treza 账户中进行渲染。您也可以使用已有的媒体素材：将片段合并到语音旁白和背景音乐中，或对单个文件进行字幕添加、画质提升、裁剪或剪辑。

您可以执行以下操作：
- 从现成模板开始，例如将长视频或播客转换为带字幕的竖版片段，或根据简要说明构建自定义流程。
- 运行流程并跟踪至最终视频成品。
- 在消费前查看运行成本，并查看您的信用余额。
- 浏览账户生成的视频、图片和音频。
- 添加您上传或链接的图片、视频或音频文件，然后进行编辑。
- 发布流程并暂停或恢复其定时任务。
- 连接您的 YouTube 频道或 TikTok 账号，在审核后将成品视频发布。只有在您点击发布时才会实际上传。

流程会消耗您 Treza 账户中的预付信用点数。连接时需通过 Google 登录，若尚未有账户将自动创建 Treza 账户。发布功能需要您拥有独立的 YouTube 频道或 TikTok 账号，可通过 Treza 在聊天中提供的链接进行连接。

payload.name: Carat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create images, video, audio, branded assets, and social content directly in ChatGPT. Start with an idea or reference files, and use Carat to plan, generate, review, edit, and export your work in one conversation.

With Carat, you can:

• Generate images and videos from text or reference media. Create portraits, illustrations, product visuals, cinematic scenes, social content, and ad creatives, or turn a still image into a video.
• Create product and brand content, including product photos, campaign visuals, short-form video ads, and coordinated social assets.
• Edit and transform existing media. Upload files for analysis, upscale images, create variations, and refine the results through conversation.
• Generate and work with audio for your creative projects.
• Inspect images, video, and audio before editing. Analyze uploaded content and technical metadata to choose suitable source material and workflows.
• Build and revise video projects in Carat Studio. Edit timelines, preview changes, and export the finished video.
• Review generated results in chat and build on previous creations without starting over.

Describe what you want to make and attach any references you need. From a single image to a multi-step video project, plan, create, and keep refining your work in the same conversation.

Connect your Carat account to get started. No separate API key is required. Generations use the same credit balance as the Carat platform.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中直接创建图像、视频、音频、品牌素材和社交内容。从一个想法或参考文件开始，使用Carat在一次对话中完成规划、生成、审阅、编辑和导出工作。

使用Carat您可以：

• 通过文本或参考素材生成图像和视频。可创建人像、插画、产品视觉、电影场景、社交内容和广告创意，或把静态图像转化为视频。
• 创建产品和品牌内容，包括产品照片、活动视觉、短视频广告和协调的社交素材。
• 编辑和改造现有媒体。上传文件进行分析，放大图像，生成变体，并通过对话优化结果。
• 为创意项目生成和处理音频。
• 在编辑前检查图像、视频和音频。分析上传内容和技术元数据，选择合适的素材和工作流程。
• 在Carat Studio中构建和修改视频项目。编辑时间线，预览更改，并导出最终视频。
• 在聊天中审阅生成结果，并在原有创作基础上持续优化而无需从头开始。

描述您想创作的内容并附加所需参考素材。从单张图像到多步骤视频项目，可在同一对话中完成规划、创作和持续优化。

连接您的Carat账户即可开始使用。无需单独的API密钥。生成内容使用与Carat平台相同的信用额度。

payload.name: Uwear
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Uwear helps fashion teams organize garments, reusable models, locations, and art direction; prepare and approve photoshoot briefs; and generate, edit, and review product images and videos using their existing Uwear account and credits.
payload.longDescription: Uwear帮助时尚团队整理服装、可重复使用的模型、拍摄地点和艺术指导；制定并审批摄影计划；并通过其现有的Uwear账户及积分生成、编辑和审核产品图片与视频。

payload.name: Atlas Cloud
payload.description: 使用400多种模型创建媒体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Generate images, videos, audio, 3D assets, and text with a live catalog of 400+ AI models. Choose video models such as Seedance, Veo, Kling, MiniMax, and Wan; image models such as GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX, and Qwen; 3D models from Hunyuan and Tripo; plus audio models from Suno, ElevenLabs, MiniMax, and Seed Audio.

With this plugin, you can:
• Generate and edit images from text, images, or supported references.
• Create text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video clips; use supported video editing, avatar, and motion-control workflows.
• Turn text or images into 3D assets; create speech and music; transcribe audio; and run supported LLMs.
• Search the live model catalog, inspect each model’s inputs, output type, and pricing, upload source media for a generation task, and track asynchronous jobs to completion.

Connect your Atlas Cloud account in the browser—no API key is required. Billable jobs charge your Atlas balance and may require confirmation before submission. Availability, inputs, output formats, processing time, and cost vary by selected model. Uploads are temporary generation inputs, not permanent file storage.
payload.longDescription:
使用400多种AI模型的直播目录生成图像,视频,音频,3D资产和文本;选择视频模型,如Seedance,Veo,Kling,MiniMax和Wan;图像模型,如GPT Image,Nano Banana,Seedream,FLUX和Qwen;来自Hunyuan和Tripo的3D模型;以及来自Suno,ElevenLabs,MiniMax和Seed Audio的音频模型。

借助此插件,您可以: • 生成和编辑来自文本,图像或支持的参考文本的图像; • 创建文本到视频,图像到视频和参考到视频的剪辑; 使用支持的视频编辑,外观和运动控制工作流程; • 将文本或图像转换为3D资产; 创建语音和音乐; 转录音频; 运行支持的LLM。

在浏览器中连接您的 Atlas Cloud 帐户 — 无需 API 密钥. 可收费的任务会收取您的 Atlas 余额,并且可能需要提交前确认。 可用性、输入、输出格式、处理时间和成本因选择的模型而异。 上传是临时生成输入,而不是永久性文件存储。

payload.name: Frameo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Frameo turns a prompt into a finished short video inside ChatGPT. It generates images, video clips, voiceovers, music, and sound effects in the user's Frameo workspace, keeps characters and style consistent across shots, and assembles the clips with ffmpeg and motion-graphics templates into a final cut. Users can also upload or import their own media, browse a free sound-effect library, and read back a project's canvas and Library. Every credit-spending generation is quoted first with estimate_cost and runs only after the user confirms.
payload.longDescription: Frameo在ChatGPT内将提示转换为完整短视频。它在用户的Frameo工作区生成图片、视频片段、配音、音乐和音效，保持镜头间角色与风格的一致性，并通过ffmpeg和动态图形模板将片段合成最终成片。用户还可上传或导入自有媒体，浏览免费音效库，查看项目的画布和素材库。每次生成前会先通过estimate_cost进行费用预估，确认后才执行生成操作。

payload.name: Pedra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pedra is the AI photo and video studio for real estate agents. Connect your Pedra account and ask ChatGPT to prepare a listing's visuals.

Virtually stage empty rooms in the style you want, empty furnished rooms, renovate spaces with new floors and finishes, enhance lighting and straighten perspective, replace a dull sky with a blue one, remove objects, or blur faces and license plates. Describe any other edit in plain words, like "paint the walls sage green".

Pedra also turns a property's photos into a listing video with animated clips, background music, a narrated voiceover, and word-synced subtitles.

Everything you create is saved to your Pedra properties, so you can keep editing in the Pedra app. Requires a Pedra account; generations use your account's credits.
payload.longDescription:
Pedra是房地产经纪人的AI照片和视频工作室。连接您的Pedra账户，让ChatGPT准备房源的视觉素材。

您可以虚拟布置空房间（按您想要的风格）、空置的家具齐全房间，用新地板和装修翻新空间，增强照明并校正透视，将阴沉的天空替换为蓝天，移除物体或模糊人脸和车牌。用简单明了的语言描述其他编辑需求，例如「将墙壁涂成鼠尾草绿」。

Pedra还能将房产照片转化为带动画片段、背景音乐、旁白和同步字幕的房源视频。

您创建的所有内容都会保存到Pedra房源中，可继续在Pedra应用中编辑。需要Pedra账户；生成内容会消耗账户积分。

payload.name: Marq
payload.description: 创建符合品牌规范的内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Marq is the Brand Enablement Platform for brand teams supporting creators across the organization. Connect Marq to ChatGPT to find brand templates and use them to create or update on-brand content like one-pagers, datasheets, and social posts. Use ChatGPT to inspect a project’s pages, text, images, and Smart Fields, then rewrite, proofread, or translate copy and replace images. You can also personalize content with user, team, or project information, populate documents from your Marq datasets, and apply Marq Brand Kit colors, fonts, and logos to supported template elements. Export finished projects as PDF, PNG, or JPG. Changes preserve existing styling and element locks, so teams can create and update content faster without losing brand or layout control. ChatGPT only works with content the signed-in user can access in Marq.
payload.longDescription: Marq 是品牌赋能平台，专为品牌团队打造，支持组织内的创作者。将 Marq 连接到 ChatGPT，查找品牌模板并使用它们创建或更新符合品牌规范的内容，例如单页文档、数据表和社交媒体帖子。使用 ChatGPT 检查项目的页面、文本、图片和智能字段，然后重写、校对或翻译文案并替换图片。您还可以通过用户、团队或项目信息个性化内容，从 Marq 数据集填充文档，并将 Marq 品牌工具包中的颜色、字体和标志应用到支持的模板元素。将完成的项目导出为 PDF、PNG 或 JPG 格式。更改会保留现有样式和元素锁定，因此团队可以更快地创建和更新内容，同时不会失去品牌或布局控制。ChatGPT 仅能处理已登录用户在 Marq 中可访问的内容。

payload.name: Swish Sports Court Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create custom basketball and other sports court designs with Swish Court Builder. Set dimensions, choose flooring and colors, adjust court markings and borders, and add sports lines, logos, and text. View 2D and 3D previews, download images or videos, and continue editing in Swish Court Builder. Customers can review and order physical court flooring through the Swish Court website.
payload.longDescription: 通过Swish Court Builder创建定制篮球场及其他运动场地设计。设置尺寸、选择地板材质和颜色、调整场地标记和边框，并添加运动线、标志和文字。查看2D和3D预览，下载图片或视频，并在Swish Court Builder中继续编辑。客户可通过Swish Court网站查看并订购实体场地地板。

payload.name: PictureBooks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create private illustrated storybooks from your ideas, follow generation progress, and read stories saved in your PictureBooks account. Built for parents, caregivers, educators, and other adult authors. Connect your existing account to check available credits and create books using those credits. The plugin does not purchase credits, charge a card, or publish your books. You can disconnect access in PictureBooks at any time.
payload.longDescription: 从您的创意出发，创建私密图文故事书，跟踪生成进度，并阅读保存在您PictureBooks账户中的故事。专为家长、看护人员、教育工作者及其他成人作者设计。连接您的现有账户以查看可用信用点，并使用这些信用点创作书籍。该插件不会购买信用点、扣费或发布您的书籍，您可随时在PictureBooks中断开访问。

payload.name: Details
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Details helps you find curated website design references, inspect images and ordered video frames, and retrieve reusable web interface resources from the Details Vault. Search by section, component, style, or interaction, compare numbered results, then inspect a selected reference or retrieve a resource's implementation instructions and documentation. A connected Details account with an eligible plan is required; available tools and usage allowances depend on your account.
payload.longDescription: Details帮助您查找精选的网站设计参考，检查图片和有序视频帧，并从Details Vault获取可重用的网页界面资源。可通过板块、组件、样式或交互方式搜索，比较编号结果，然后检查选定的参考内容或获取资源的实现说明和文档。需要连接符合资格计划的Details账户；可用工具和使用配额取决于您的账户。

payload.name: Planner 5D: Design & Planning
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan a renovation, see how furniture fits, explore a new home, or create visuals for your next project.
Create and edit floor plans, try different layouts, arrange furniture, and visualize interiors, buildings, and outdoor spaces in 2D and 3D. Explore ideas for your own home, client projects, or property presentations.
Turn photos, sketches, and references into images and videos. Compare styles, materials, and design options, or create visual content beyond home design.
Work with plans, specifications, quotes, and project documents. Organize materials and costs, compare options, and prepare clear briefs and presentations.
Start with an idea, a photo, a floor plan, or your project files. Develop your work through conversation and continue refining it in Planner 5D.

payload.name: WalkMyPlan — Floor Plans in 3D
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a garden" — then "walk me through it."

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and your OS's file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple hosts and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit config files, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.
payload.longDescription:
SentinelX 可让您通过 ChatGPT 管理 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器——无需 SSH。在任意 Linux、macOS 或 Windows 主机上安装小型开源代理，ChatGPT 即可执行检测命令、管理服务（systemd、launchd 或 Windows 服务）、读取/搜索/编辑文件、运行脚本、上传文件，并调用 Cloudflare DNS、Resend 和 Telegram 等集成服务。

所有操作均受您控制的每台主机允许列表约束。代理仅执行您明确声明安全的命令和服务，在代理边界拒绝所有策略外请求，同时您的操作系统文件权限仍作为额外保护层。您可以连接多台主机并按自定义方式标记它们。

典型使用场景：检查运行时间和磁盘空间、重启服务、实时查看日志、编辑配置文件、运行快速脚本、管理 DNS 记录、发送通知。代理在 GitHub 开源（github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core）。认证采用 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 和动态客户端注册机制，按用户粒度授权。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Engram gives your AI assistant long-term memory. It stores your conversations verbatim and makes them searchable by meaning, so context, decisions, and preferences carry across sessions instead of being forgotten. Ask it to remember something and recall it days or weeks later. Your memory is private to your account and works across the MCP clients you connect.
payload.longDescription: Engram 会为您的 AI 助理提供长期记忆,它会将您的对话存储在口头上,并使其可根据含义进行搜索,因此背景、决策和偏好会传递到会话中,而不是被遗忘。

payload.name: Web on Demand Website Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, edit, and publish complete websites directly from ChatGPT using Web on Demand. Create responsive, production-ready websites with modern layouts, custom content, and interactive features—then deploy them instantly without complicated setup, plugins, or traditional back-end development.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Web on Demand，直接在 ChatGPT 中构建、编辑和发布完整的网站。使用现代布局、自定义内容和交互功能创建响应式、可投入生产的网站——然后无需复杂设置、插件或传统后端开发即可立即部署。

payload.name: YepCode
payload.description: 构建并运行自定义AI工具
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and run custom AI tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
YepCode lets you build custom AI tools using your own code with JSON Schema-defined inputs, executed in an isolated sandbox with access to any npm or PyPI package and secure environment variables.

Define reusable processes in Node.js or Python, expose them as callable AI tools, and execute them on demand or on a schedule. Every run is logged and auditable, enabling traceable, production-grade AI integrations.

Built for developers who need programmable, observable AI tool execution.
payload.longDescription:
YepCode允许您通过自定义代码构建AI工具，使用JSON Schema定义输入参数，在隔离的沙盒环境中运行，可访问任何npm或PyPI包以及安全环境变量。

在Node.js或Python中定义可重用流程，将其作为可调用的AI工具暴露，并按需或定时执行。每次运行都会被记录并可审计，实现可追溯的生产级AI集成。

专为需要可编程、可观察AI工具执行的开发者设计。

payload.name: Sticklight
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sticklight is an AI-powered builder designed for professional web creators who want to build real digital products faster - without compromising on quality, control, or design standards.
You start by describing what you want to create in natural language, and Sticklight generates a working project with structure, interface, and core logic already in place. From there, creators can refine every detail - manually editing elements, adjusting layouts and interactions, and accessing the underlying code whenever needed. This allows professionals to keep full control over every pixel and maintain the level of craft their work demands.

What makes Sticklight especially valuable for experienced creators is the ability to produce non-generic results. Instead of templated outputs, the platform is designed to support custom design decisions and unique product ideas while still accelerating the building process. Creators can combine AI-assisted generation with their own expertise to deliver polished, high-quality experiences that are ready for real users and real traffic.

With Sticklight, creators can build complete applications - including dashboards, client portals, internal tools, MVPs, marketing platforms, and interactive products - not just static sites. The result is a stable, flexible environment where professionals can move from idea to fully functional application while maintaining the precision, reliability, and creative control their work requires.
payload.longDescription:
Sticklight是一款专为专业网页创作者设计的AI驱动构建工具，帮助他们更快打造真正的数字产品——同时不牺牲质量、控制或设计标准。您可以通过自然语言描述想要创建的内容，Sticklight将生成包含结构、界面和核心逻辑的可运行项目。创作者可在此基础上完善每个细节，手动编辑元素、调整布局与交互，并在需要时访问底层代码，从而确保对每个像素的完全掌控，维持作品所需的工艺水准。

对经验丰富的创作者而言，Sticklight的特殊价值在于能产出非通用化成果。平台不提供模板化输出，而是支持自定义设计决策和独特产品构思，同时保持开发加速优势。创作者可将AI辅助生成与自身专业技能结合，交付经过打磨的高质量体验，满足真实用户和流量的需求。

通过Sticklight，创作者可以构建完整应用程序——包括仪表盘、客户门户、内部工具、MVP、营销平台和交互式产品——而不仅仅是静态网站。这创造了一个稳定灵活的环境，使专业人士能从创意快速过渡到完整功能应用，同时保持对精度、可靠性及创作控制的严格要求。

payload.name: Themely Design+Style Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
通过AI为应用程序、网站、仪表板、着陆页等创建精美设计主题。描述您的需求，探索不同视觉风格，对比不同创意方案，并在几秒钟内预览您的设计概念。无论您是从空白页面开始还是需要更新现有方案，此工具都能在无需高级设计技能的情况下，帮助您快速发现设计方向。

只需告诉ChatGPT您想打造什么。您可以请求移动应用、网站、在线商店、作品集、博客、仪表板、管理面板、营销页面或几乎任何数字产品。然后描述您想要的情感、目标受众、颜色或风格。AI会将您的想法转化为易于探索和优化的精致设计主题。

无需从头开始即可尝试多种不同风格。生成干净、现代、极简、有趣、暗色、多彩、高端、未来感、玻璃质感、柔和、大胆、优雅或创意主题。通过对比不同风格，找到最符合您项目、品牌或个人品味的方案。您对提示的微小调整就能产生新创意，帮助您以全新方式思考。

在投入时间设计或开发前预览您的创意。早期看到不同主题能更轻松地选择颜色、布局、排版、间距和整体视觉方向。您可以快速判断哪些方案可行，哪些需要调整，再进入设计或开发阶段。

该工具适用于设计师、开发者、创业者、学生、营销人员、创作者、广告公司及所有需要视觉灵感的人群。它可以帮您为企业网站、创业着陆页、移动应用、软件仪表板、电商平台、教育平台、作品集、旅游网站、金融应用、健康应用、效率工具、娱乐服务等探索创意。

当需要灵感、想突破创作瓶颈或单纯想看到新可能时使用。只需片刻就能生成大量设计方向，而非在无尽图库中搜索。探索符合您目标的创意并持续优化，直到找到喜爱的风格。

尝试色彩搭配、页面布局、界面风格、导航方式、按钮设计、卡片布局、表单设计、图标风格、内容板块、排版体系和视觉层级。可以要求受现代趋势或经典设计原则启发的主题。将不同创意混合，为您的项目打造独特方案。

AI能理解简单指令，因此无需专业设计术语。用日常语言描述您的项目。您可以详细说明或简要概括。要求修改方案、请求其他风格或继续探索，直到结果符合预期。每个新提示都能带来全新概念和意外灵感。

无论您是规划首个网站还是改进数以千计用户使用的产品，此工具都能让早期设计探索更快更简单。它帮助您发现主题、对比视觉方向，并在投入详细设计工作前建立信心。

非常适合头脑风暴、创意探索、产品规划、设计评审、客户演示、原型设计、概念开发和视觉灵感。借助ChatGPT将简单想法转化为吸引人的设计主题，探索多种可能性，找到最契合您项目的外观。

payload.name: Create State
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create State gives ChatGPT persistent memory for your software projects. Save code snippets, architectural decisions, and debugging insights to a personal knowledge graph. Pick up exactly where you left off in future conversations.
payload.longDescription: Create State 为 ChatGPT 提供软件项目所需的持久记忆功能。可将代码片段、架构决策和调试洞察保存至个人知识图谱，在未来的对话中准确接续之前的内容。

payload.name: Adalo
payload.description: 构建和管理无代码应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and manage no-code apps entirely through conversation.  Adalo's ChatGPT integration lets you create, modify, and   manage mobile and web applications without ever leaving the    chat. Just describe what you want — Adalo's AI builds it   for you.
payload.longDescription: 通过对话完全实现无代码应用的构建与管理。Adalo的ChatGPT集成让您能够在不离开聊天界面的情况下，创建、修改和管理移动及网络应用。只需描述你的需求——Adalo的AI会为你构建。

payload.name: Context.dev
payload.summaryOriginal: Live web data for AI agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Context turns the live web and files into clean, agent-ready data inside ChatGPT. Search for current information, read a known page as Markdown, crawl websites, extract schema-shaped JSON, parse documents, retrieve company and brand intelligence, inspect visual design systems, run asynchronous scraping batches across thousands of URLs, and monitor websites for meaningful changes over time. Some scraping tools can perform explicitly requested browser actions to reveal content. Context does not provide general messaging, calendar, account-management, or social-publishing integrations.
payload.longDescription: Context将实时网络内容和文件转化为ChatGPT内部的结构化数据。可搜索实时信息、以Markdown格式阅读指定页面、爬取网站、提取结构化JSON、解析文档、获取企业与品牌情报、检查视觉设计系统、对数千个URL执行异步抓取任务，并长期监控网站以发现有意义的变化。部分抓取工具可执行明确请求的浏览器操作来展示内容。Context不提供通用消息、日历、账户管理或社交媒体发布集成。

payload.name: PageShare
payload.description: 分享并保护由ChatGPT生成的HTML页面
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PageShare lets you share and protect HTML pages generated with ChatGPT. Publish new and update existing pages, control access with passwords or email rules, manage custom domains and tracking links, and review analytics for your sites.
payload.longDescription: PageShare允许您分享并保护由ChatGPT生成的HTML页面。可发布新页面或更新现有页面，通过密码或电子邮件规则控制访问权限，管理自定义域名和跟踪链接，并查看网站分析数据。

payload.name: Catalyst by Zoho
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Catalyst by Zoho is a full-stack development platform for building web applications, APIs, automation workflows, and AI-powered software. The Codex plugin helps developers use Catalyst services directly from their coding workflow, making it easier to create backends, manage databases and storage, deploy applications, automate tasks, and integrate with Zoho and external services without switching between multiple tools.
payload.longDescription: Catalyst by Zoho 是一个全栈开发平台，可用于构建网页应用、API、自动化工作流以及人工智能驱动的软件。Codex 插件帮助开发者直接在编码流程中使用 Catalyst 服务，更轻松地创建后端、管理数据库和存储、部署应用、自动化任务，并与 Zoho 及外部服务集成，而无需在多个工具间切换。

payload.name: Jam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jam's MCP is the fast lane between Jam recordings and your dev tools. Drop a Jam link into ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude and the whole recording – video, console, network, logs – arrives pre-packaged. No hand-typing repro steps, no copy-paste stack traces, no screen-share drama. Your tools get instant context, you stay in flow.
payload.longDescription: Jam的MCP是Jam录音与开发工具之间的快速通道。将Jam链接粘贴到ChatGPT、VS Code、Cursor、Windsurf或Claude中，完整的录音内容——视频、控制台、网络数据、日志——会以预装格式送达。无需手动输入复现步骤，无需复制粘贴堆栈跟踪，无需屏幕共享的麻烦。您的工具将获得即时上下文，您能保持流畅的工作状态。

payload.name: 3Min API
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 3Min API lets you create REST APIs without writing backend code. Define a JSON schema, and get full CRUD endpoints with automatic webhook delivery, sandbox/production separation, real-time logs, and usage statistics. Manage everything through natural language — create endpoints, test API calls, search logs, invite collaborators, deploy to production, and generate ready-to-paste WordPress plugin snippets that render your endpoints on any WordPress page.
payload.longDescription: 3Min API 使您无需编写后端代码即可创建REST API。定义JSON架构，即可获得包含自动网络钩子交付、沙箱/生产环境分离、实时日志和使用统计的全功能CRUD端点。通过自然语言管理所有功能——创建端点、测试API调用、搜索日志、邀请协作者、部署到生产环境，并生成可直接粘贴的WordPress插件代码片段，可在任何WordPress页面上渲染您的端点。

payload.name: Hot100.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hot100 lets you search and browse hundreds of AI projects, tools, and agents. Ranked weekly and tagged by stack, use case, and builder tools like Cursor & Replit. Find inspiration, explore what’s shipping, and stay on top of the AI ecosystem.
payload.longDescription: Hot100允许您搜索和浏览数百个AI项目,工具和代理,每周排名并按堆栈,使用案例和构建工具标记,如Cursor & Replit。

payload.name: WoWSQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WoWSQL lets users manage their PostgreSQL database-as-a-service projects directly from ChatGPT. Users can list and inspect projects, browse database tables, execute SQL queries and statements, search platform documentation, read full doc pages, and list file storage buckets — all within their authenticated WoWSQL workspace.
payload.longDescription: WoWSQL 允许用户直接从 ChatGPT 管理其 PostgreSQL 数据库即服务项目。用户可以列出并检查项目、浏览数据库表、执行 SQL 查询和语句、搜索平台文档、阅读完整文档页面以及列出文件存储桶——所有操作均在其已认证的 WoWSQL 工作区中完成。

payload.name: DNS Inspector
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DNS Inspector looks up the main DNS record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA) for any domain and displays them in a clear, readable widget, with one-click refresh and copy-to-clipboard for each value.
payload.longDescription: DNS Inspector 可针对任意域名即时查询主要DNS记录类型（A、AAAA、CNAME、MX、TXT、NS、SOA），并以清晰易读的组件展示结果，每个数值均支持一键刷新和复制功能。

payload.name: Botpress
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Complete AI Agent Platform

Botpress is an all-in-one platform for building AI agents powered by the latest LLMs. Use this application to rapidly prototype agents that can do FAQ, sales, support and so much more!

How it works:
1. Tag @Botpress in your chat and ask ChatGPT to create an agent with Botpress.
2. Iterate on design, business logic, information sources and more through natural language!
3. Once deployed, with the click of a button, you can open your agent in Botpress to access a comprehensive visual agent builder.
payload.longDescription:
完整的AI代理平台

Botpress是基于最新大型语言模型的全功能AI代理开发平台，可通过该应用快速构建可执行常见问题解答、销售支持、客户服务等任务的AI代理！

工作原理：
1. 在聊天中@Botpress，并让ChatGPT使用Botpress创建一个代理。
2. 通过自然语言迭代设计、业务逻辑、信息来源等要素。
3. 部署完成后，点击按钮即可在Botpress中打开代理，使用全面的可视化代理构建工具。

payload.name: Outside Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Outside Agent turns a plain-language brief into a hosted AI agent you can publish to SMS, voice, and web without leaving your coding agent. Describe what the agent should do and it composes the full configuration, grounds it in your own content, runs a safety review, and ships it. Create agents, seed a knowledge base, preview replies before publishing, issue a phone number, and manage everything you’ve built, all through natural conversation.
payload.longDescription: 外部代理将简单的简介转化为托管的AI代理,您可以发布到SMS、语音和网络中,而不离开编码代理人。 描述代理人应该做什么,并组成完整的配置,在自己的内容中建立基础,运行安全审查,并发送它。
